task.title: Use the kit Genbeya builds
task.body:
Waits for Genbeya to ship [[Kit build]]. Until then `tool/build_kit` builds the same bundle from Genbeya's sources ([[GM-3]]), so nothing in the app waits for this (D2 in [[Decisions]]).

- [ ] `tool/build_kit` downloads `genbeya-kit-<version>.zip` of the release named in `kit/GENBEYA_REF` and checks every file against its `manifest.json`
- [ ] The app refuses a kit whose `protocol` on `ready` it doesn't speak
- [ ] Remove `kit/src/` once Genbeya's `src/shells/kit/` replaces it; keep the source build for the nightly job against `develop`
- [ ] Note the Genbeya version in [[Upstream]]
